//: The getting-started course, as `public/lessons.js` in prospektor-ai/studio holds it, read out of that checkout by `npm run lessons:snapshot`. Do not hand-edit: `/learn/` draws these pages from it (#742) and `tools/resources-coverage.js` checks their names against the product.

lessons.subject: Where the studio starts you
lessons.opener: Every sign-in lands on Getting started: your name, and one box asking what you want to do today.
bullets: Type it in your own words. Name a company, or say the kind you are after.
The studio opens the screen that does it, with what you typed already in its box.
Nothing runs until you press the button there, and a question opens the support chat.
lessons.close: Under the box, Find and Engage: the seven things the studio can do. Press one, or type instead.
lessons.label: Open Getting started

lessons.subject: The companies waiting under Leads for you
lessons.opener: Leads for you holds companies the studio thinks you should approach, each with a fit score out of 100 and one line on why.
bullets: Glance reads one in fifteen seconds. Prospekt writes the rest.
Skip teaches the studio what not to bring back. The shelf refills on its own.
Who we hunt, on the sidebar, is the sentence the shelf is built from.
lessons.close: Change that sentence and the shelf changes with it.
lessons.label: Open Leads for you

lessons.subject: What one Prospekt gives you
lessons.opener: One press on Prospekt buys the research, the fit case, who decides, and every deliverable your workspace has switched on, written in your voice.
bullets: It runs in the background. Leave the screen and it finishes without you.
Every claim carries the page it came from.
The finished pitch lands in the Library and, if you want, in your inbox.
lessons.close: Read one all the way to the end today. Tomorrow you fix a line in it.
lessons.label: Open the Library

lessons.subject: One edit teaches the studio your voice
lessons.opener: A saved edit is a lesson. Fix one sentence you would never send, save it, and every later pitch is written with that in mind.
bullets: Open a pitch in the Library and press Edit on any deliverable.
Change the one line that is not you. Leave the rest.
Save. The studio keeps the before and the after as a voice record.
lessons.close: Eight of those and the pitches stop needing the edit.
lessons.label: Open the Library

lessons.subject: Say what happened, and the next pitch is better
lessons.opener: Outcomes is the part of the studio that compounds. A recorded outcome is what every later pitch, prep sheet and evaluation is written from.
bullets: Press the badge on any lead: replied, meeting, won, lost, or never answered. Or open Outcomes and type any company, found here or not.
Add one line in your own words. That line is worth more than the badge.
Make sense of this reads the record back: what won, what lost, and what to ask next.
lessons.close: A workspace that records nothing gets run 1 on run 100. Record one today.
lessons.label: Open Outcomes

lessons.subject: Import who your team knows
lessons.opener: Your network turns a cold pitch into a warm one. Import it once and every pitch after it checks who already knows the way in.
bullets: Export your LinkedIn connections as Connections.csv and drop it on Your network.
Or paste a list of names and companies. Either works.
Email addresses are dropped at import. Only you can remove what you imported.
lessons.close: Five minutes, once. Tomorrow you see what it finds.
lessons.label: Open Your network

lessons.subject: Warm paths: you, a connector, the target
lessons.opener: Every finished pitch now has a Warm paths panel: who you know that knows the decision-makers, ranked, with the evidence beside each route.
bullets: It opens with who you already know there, before any search.
Each path comes with a forwardable intro request, written in your voice.
A pitch that predates your import finds its paths on demand.
lessons.close: Open your best pitch and read the panel. That is the email to send first.
lessons.label: Open the Library

lessons.subject: Let your own tools call the studio
lessons.opener: A token lets something that is not a browser talk to your workspace: your CRM, a script, an agent you are building.
bullets: Workspace settings, Connect your apps, Your own agent, New token. Tick what it may do and when it expires.
The secret is shown once. Copy it then.
Every call answers with the same sources the studio shows you.
lessons.close: Only the workspace owner sees it. That is the whole course. Reply to this email and a person reads it.
lessons.label: Open Workspace settings
